Roffman Miller Associates Increased Bank Of America (BAC) Position; Telemus Capital Trimmed Its Target (TGT) Holding by $613,248
May 15, 2018 - By Henry Gaston
Roffman Miller Associates Inc increased its stake in Bank Of America Corp (BAC) by 65.29% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Roffman Miller Associates Inc bought 92,005 shares as the company’s stock declined 1.20% with the market. The institutional investor held 232,932 shares of the major banks company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $6.88 million, up from 140,927 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Roffman Miller Associates Inc who had been investing in Bank Of America Corp for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $316.55 billion market cap company. The stock increased 0.32% or $0.1 $31.22. About 62.02M shares traded. Bank of America Corporation (NYSE:BAC) has risen 28.18% uptrending. It has outperformed by 16.63% the S&P500.
Telemus Capital Llc decreased its stake in Target Corp (TGT) by 91.72% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Telemus Capital Llc sold 9,582 shares as the company’s stock rose 4.77% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 865 shares of the department and specialty retail stores company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $56,000, down from 10,447 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Telemus Capital Llc who had been investing in Target Corp for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $39.17 billion market cap company. The stock increased 1.11% or $0.8 $73.08. About 4.98M shares traded. Target Corporation (NYSE:TGT) has risen 28.46% uptrending. It has outperformed by 16.91% the S&P500.
